title: Shanghai building footprints from Overture Maps
release_retention: Response advertises 60-day release retention. Resolve the latest STAC release at runtime instead of permanently pinning a tile URL.
attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; © Overture Maps Foundation; Qian Shi et al. (East Asian Buildings)

primary_china_source.title: A First High-quality Vector Data of Buildings in East Asian Countries Based on a Comprehensive Large-scale Mapping Framework

sample_download.selection: Each district walk start ±500m square. Footprints selected by centroid; full polygons retained. Adjacent tile pieces merged by ID; geometry holes preserved.
sample_download.coverage_warning: These sixteen downloadable extracts are central-neighborhood samples, not offline copies of the entire districts. The browser streams worldwide Overture footprints on demand for the full Shanghai view.

quality_notes: Building footprints are sourced geometry, not randomly generated blocks.
Most features lack measured heights or floor counts. Missing-height extrusion is a visualization assumption and must not be described as a measured building height.
Footprints can reflect different source acquisition dates; a release date is not a survey date.
MVT at maximum source zoom14 has quantized/generalized geometry; it is suitable for city visualization, not cadastral measurement.
The combined buildings theme is ODbL; the East Asian Buildings contributor is CC BY4.0. Keep data attribution separate from application code licenses.
